title: The time-stamp check also covers page item and roadmap step writes
why: Triage 6 stamped page item 364 at 14:16 CST while the clock read 14:14 CST. #1447 checks send_message bodies only.
note: Stacked on #1447. Coordinator pick, 14:48 CST (#1447): the stamp guard refuses only a stamp more than 1 minute AHEAD of the clock, not one 3 min off either way. Every incident today ran ahead (2, 8-25 min); a kept old value is always behind, and the symmetric rule both missed the 2-min incident and refused kept old values. Measured by lane pr-state-is-on-the-pr from queue times (coordinator, 15:10 CST): the coordinator's message labels ran 16-23 min ahead of the clock before about 14:30 CST. Roadmap and page text that cites a coordinator time before 14:30 CST may be that far ahead; the delivery time is the true one.
